project.name: claude-code-earshot
project.description: Earshot, an accessibility mod for Claude Code aimed at blind developers: an overlay on the built-in screen reader mode (--ax-screen-reader) that enables the mode when a screen reader is detected, shows each answer whole instead of streaming it, hides or condenses tool rows, says when a turn starts and that work goes on, and speaks in the system's language. Project of the Unlocked Spark Foundation.
project.author: Łukasz Majewski
project.adoption_notes: Repository existed as notes only (README and a Polish research note dated 2026-10-09, one commit). No code before ADD. Repository content is English; research notes under docs/research/ stay Polish. Repository public since 2026-10-11 (Apache 2.0). Directory and repository renamed from claude-code-a11y to claude-code-earshot on 2026-10-10; the plugin is earshot.

maturity.next_promotion_criteria: Alpha: specs for the critical paths exist (4, implemented), unit and mod tests run in CI (GitHub Actions, 159 + 36), commit convention applied. Missing evidence: a formally run manual protocol per spec with captures (only tool narration TC-003 recorded on NVDA), and a coverage gate in CI. Run /add:promote once the protocols are run.

languages.name: javascript
languages.version: Node 22 for tooling only (npm, Vitest, ESLint); the mod itself runs inside the Claude Code process

backend.runtime: Claude Code mod runtime (>= 2.1.287, type definitions checked for 2.1.295): hooks/hooks.json points at a TypeScript module exporting register(on, options)

frontend.framework: Claude Code mod surfaces (Spinner, ToolProgress, AskUserQuestion, ToolUse, ToolResult, AbovePrompt, Pane) plus $.audio, $.ui, $.process, $.fs APIs

database.type: none ($.store up to 4 MiB for mod state; ~/.claude/settings.json for axScreenReader)

cicd.notes: On every push to main and every pull request: unit tests, lint, claude plugin validate . and claude plugin test .

local.manual_test: Full session with VoiceOver (macOS) and NVDA (Windows): install from shell, restart, prompt, answer an AskUserQuestion, approve a permission, hear end of turn.

production.deploy_trigger: manual: the repository is its own public marketplace; users run claude plugin install earshot --marketplace unlocked-spark/claude-code-earshot; a release is a version bump in .claude-plugin/plugin.json pushed to main
verify: manual session with NVDA and VoiceOver

quality.coverage_notes: No coverage gate at POC. Target 50% of src/classify and src/speech at Alpha. Screen reader behaviour is verified manually; every sound must have a text equivalent that the screen reader can read.

source_control.commit_convention_notes: Imperative English sentence describing the effect, no type prefix, no AI attribution. Deliberate departure from conventional commits.
